scope: Manually registered, content-addressed validation adapters; registration is counted as a manual input and is not part of the generic warning rules.

manual_inputs: content-addressed association with the existing mechanism-derived foreign-contract-note fixture
routes.scope_note: Injected M-DOM only. The fixture uses NoirJS execute (the pinned project's supported ACVM route), then bb.js proof generation, generated-verifier acceptance, and unchanged-consumer state checks. It makes no live-chain or arbitrary-attacker claim.

failed_routes.reason: D1P-30 output directory was absent after the first proof was generated; evidence write failed with ENOENT. The corrective run only created that directory.
The concrete fixture is constructed in TypeScript and has no complete Prover.toml; the supported equivalent is NoirJS execute over the same compiled artifact.

stages.name: concrete_witness
stages.explanation: A distinct foreign note-contract case and admitted owned-local roots were constructed.

stages.name: noir_execute
stages.explanation: NoirJS executed the concrete witness against the compiled M-DOM artifact without weakening constraints.

stages.name: real_proof
stages.explanation: bb.js generated and verified a real proof and the generated Solidity verifier accepted it.

stages.name: consumer_replay
stages.explanation: The unchanged local consumer accepted the foreign-note proof, wrote the nullifier, minted the state-checked amount, and the pinned producer rejected the same foreign witness.
